## Known biases

Curves F2.1 to F2.3 (substations) are identical for the three voltage classes and stop at 3.05 m depth with damage factor 0.16; there are no values above 3.05 m although the sheet&\#x27;s depth column runs to 6.5 m, so a table to a deeper maximum would need an extrapolation or cap rule that is not in the source. Damage factors are fractions (0 to 1); the sheet itself gives no source for the F2 curves in the columns read (that is in Table D1).
